svg.title: AWS Chatbot Architecture
svg.desc: Official-style reference architecture for the serverless Bedrock RAG proof of concept and the alternative LibreChat deployment on Amazon EC2.
svg.text: Terraform implementation with two independent deployment options in AWS Region ap-northeast-1
React + CloudFront + API Gateway + Lambda + Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
Option B — LibreChat on Amazon EC2
Official LibreChat Docker Compose stack with Amazon Bedrock model access
Default VPC · Security group allows TCP 80
Embedding model: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings v2 · Vector dimensions: 1024 · Distance metric: cosine
Runtime response includes Bedrock session ID and citations derived from retrieved S3 documents.
EC2 root volume: encrypted gp3, 30 GiB · IMDSv2 required · Bedrock credentials use the instance profile.
AWS Architecture Icons: official AWS Architecture Icons package, Icon-package_04302026
